bundled.built_from: calcurse 4.8.2 source from https://calcurse.org/files/calcurse-4.8.2.tar.gz (SHA-256 849ba852c7f37b6772365cb0c42a94cde0fe75efba91363e96a0e7ef797ba565), configured with --prefix=/usr --disable-docs on Ubuntu 24.04 amd64; includes pbsandbox.so compiled from the accompanying pbsandbox.c with gcc -shared -fPIC -O2 -ldl.

modifications: Upstream source is unchanged. A separate pbsandbox preload library confines the process.
configuration: HOME and the working directory are DATA_DIR, initially empty. A preloaded libfaketime fixes the wall clock; pbsandbox confines file access with Landlock and denies creation of external processes. Native calendar, to-do, note and configuration files persist under DATA_DIR.

build.sandbox: pbsandbox.c is compiled as a shared library with gcc -shared -fPIC -O2 -ldl; it confines the unmodified upstream process before main.

environment_dependency.name: libfaketime
environment_dependency.purpose: Supplies a fixed wall clock to the application; installed with its license in the shared execution environment.
